title: Closed Doors
description: The Admin console link is only for people who should be behind that door — FR-604 says role-gated UI must hide what a role can't use, not just block it after the click. Confirm the nav itself never offers the door to non-admins.
successCondition: Logged in as customer@swiftcargo.test or a driver/dispatcher account, the left nav (rendered by NavShell) contains no link with the text "Admin console" anywhere in the DOM. Logged in as admin@swiftcargo.test, the same nav does contain it.
hints: Compare the rendered nav across at least two roles rather than trusting a single login.
This is a rendering check, not a routing check — don't just test that navigating to /admin redirects; assert the link is absent from the DOM.
